name: a huge view count rolls up beside a rising trend line
looks: A short mono caption sits above a huge number that rolls up digit by digit, a plus sign punctuating it, with a caption beneath naming what it counts; beside it a thin accent line draws itself rising left to right, ending in a small dot.
build: data-infographic for the digit roll-up (vertical blur during the count, landing on power3.out); easing-graph-draw for the trend line (progressive lineTo reveal up to current time, an uneven uphill slope).
sound: A rising tone under the roll-up, a soft tick as the line's dot lands.
prompt: Roll a huge number up digit by digit beside a short caption naming what it measures, a plus sign marking it as still growing. Draw a thin rising trend line beside it that climbs unevenly left to right and ends on a small dot, so the number and its trajectory read together.
